mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.sender_id AS senderId, m.content, m.state FROM tree_hole_message_visible v INNER JOIN tree_hole_message m ON v.message_id = m.id WHERE v.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND (m.state IS NULL OR m.state != 2) ORDER BY v.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
